test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
"Eight people – K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table. Some face the center, and some face outward.

L sits second to the right of K (who faces the center).

M sits immediately to the left of L (who faces outward).

N sits opposite M (who faces inward).

O, who faces outward, sits third to the right of N (who faces outward).

P sits between O and Q.

If Q faces outward, who is sitting immediately to the left of Q?
solution:
Given: Eight people K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table.

1) L sits second to the right of K (who faces the center).

2) M sits immediately to the left of L (who faces outward).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711fc3fcf62b99a5a377ad32a91c86b7ca814e59c1043c1ffa135c84dde6152f.png]
